# Lending Policy: Default Risk and Collateral Monitoring

Department: CRL
Document Type: Lending Policy
Ref ID: CRL-BATCH-100
Date: 2026-04-04

---

We need to review the default risk quarterly.
We need to update the default risk based on audit.
We need to investigate the default risk standard update.
We need to monitor the collateral value quarterly.
We need to review the collateral value urgently.
